ui:help.en: The file written by `gcloud auth application-default login` (application_default_credentials.json, "type": "authorized_user"). Paste the whole file. Stored encrypted; the access token is fetched automatically after saving (an older core can take up to five minutes) and then renewed automatically.
ui:help.zh: `gcloud auth application-default login` 生成的文件（application_default_credentials.json，"type" 为 "authorized_user"）。粘贴整个文件的内容。加密保存；保存后自动获取访问令牌（旧版核心最多等待 5 分钟），之后自动续期。

ui:help.en: The project requests are billed to. Leave empty only when the file has a quota_project_id.
ui:help.zh: 请求计费的项目。只有凭证文件里带 quota_project_id 时才可以留空。

ui:help.en: The Vertex AI location requests go to: global (host aiplatform.googleapis.com) or a region such as us-central1, europe-west4 or asia-northeast1 (host <region>-aiplatform.googleapis.com). Not every model is served in every location.
ui:help.zh: 请求发往的 Vertex AI 区域：global（主机 aiplatform.googleapis.com），或 us-central1、europe-west4、asia-northeast1 这样的区域（主机 <区域>-aiplatform.googleapis.com）。并非每个模型在每个区域都可用。
